Caveats for EUR
  • 3 cycles spanning very different macro regimes (Trichet 2005 / aborted Apr-11 / post-COVID Jul-22). Effective N on similarity weighting ~2.1 (Dec-05 dominates at ~65%) -- treat as concentrated.
  • Apr-11 was the famous ECB 'policy mistake' cycle, fully reversed within months. It's included but pulls the average toward a peculiar shape.
  • Cash uses EUSA (6M EURIBOR swaps), forwards use SD0045FS. The two curves align in level so the basis is small, but they're not strictly identical -- a residual offset of a few bp can show up in carry.
